Given- 7 1 6 2 8

Rule No. (1): This condition does not apply because the 1st digit (7) is odd, not even.

Rule No. (2): This condition does not apply because the last digit (8) is even, not odd.

Rule No. (3): This condition applies because the 3rd digit (6) is even and the 4th digit (2) is also even. So, their codes will be interchanged.

Based on the applicable rule (3), the 3rd and 4th digits' codes are interchanged.

The code for 7 is Z.

The code for 1 is J.

The original code for 6 is T.

The original code for 2 is *.

So, 6 will be coded as * 

And 2 will be coded as T 

The code for 8 is Q.

Thus, '7 1 6 2 8' is coded as → Z J * T Q.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
